$comment: Entry schema for contributes.fileDecorations (process plugins only, manifest apiVersion 2, requires the workspace.read capability). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_file_decorations.go; the CLI mirrors it in tools/mincode-cli/data_providers.go. A plugin declares at most 1 provider (contract maxEntries). action must name one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read' that is not aiCallable. The provider shows a badge or a colour dot after file names in the project file tree; the host calls the action only when the user expands a directory, after an in-place tree refresh, or after the plugin calls host.decorations.refresh (host 0.3.0; a data-free hint limited to one per {{limits.refreshHintMinIntervalMs}} ms that answers {"scheduled": bool}). Payload: {provider, project: {name, root}, directory, names, locale}: directory is "" (the project root) or a clean project-relative path of at most {{limits.directoryMaxBytes}} bytes that stays inside the project with symlinks resolved (VCS directories are refused); names are 1-{{limits.namesMax}} single-segment child names of at most {{limits.nameMaxBytes}} bytes, duplicates removed and sensitive names (.env, id_rsa, ...) left out. The host never stats the names. Payload at most min(action maxPayloadBytes, {{limits.payloadMaxBytes}}) bytes. Expected result: {"decorations": {"<name>": {badge?, color?, tooltip?}}} (<= {{limits.resultMaxBytes}} bytes): a key that was not requested is dropped; badge is 1-{{limits.badgeMaxRunes}} letters, digits, punctuation or symbols (no spaces, control or format characters); color is one of {{lists.colors}} (theme token names only, never a CSS value); tooltip is one line of at most {{limits.tooltipMaxRunes}} characters; an item without badge and color, or with any invalid field, is dropped. File names are never restyled. Timeout {{limits.timeoutMs}} ms, {{limits.concurrentPerPlugin}} request in flight per plugin.
description: File decoration provider: shows a short badge or a colour dot after file names in the project file tree.

action.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read' that is not aiCallable.
